Infrastructure Financing and Securitisation

Principal Investment Officer (Risk Management) - IFS

HKMC commenced its business in the area of Infrastructure Financing and Securitisation (IFS) in 2019. To support the growing business, we are now inviting high-calibre individuals to consider the following opening in our IFS Division.

 

Job Descriptions
  • Assist Head of Infrastructure Risk to drive the development, implementation and continuous improvement of the risk management framework in commensuration with the market positioning, business targets, and the scale and pace of business participation contemplated by the HKMC;
  • Take charge in evaluating credit proposals, conducting due diligence and providing inputs and advice to the investment team and senior management, as an integral part of the deal investment process;
  • Undertake responsibilities over the loan portfolio including, among others, periodic monitoring and reporting, early actions on credit deterioration, and stress tests;
  • Organise and assist in investment committee meetings and processes;
  • Lead or conduct ad hoc research or studies relevant to the development of the business portfolio from a risk governance perspective;
  • Coach junior members of the team;
  • Support securitisation of infrastructure assets; and
  • Support new product innovation.

 

Requirements
  • Degree holder preferably in Risk Management, Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, International Business or Investment;
  • A minimum of 12 years’ work experience in renowned institutional banks, institutional investors or advisory firms primarily in infrastructure financing, advisory or investment with team leadership responsibility. Experience and knowledge in securitisation would be an advantage;
  • Strong commercial acumen, and excellent communication and presentation capabilities;
  • Strong analytical and excellent stakeholder engagement skills; and
  • Ability in handling complex transaction structure, financial model and documentation.

 

(Closing Date: 28 October 2026)

HKMC Insurance Limited

Manager (Loan Guarantee Schemes – Special Assets Management)

We are looking for high-calibre individuals who want to be part of the Special Assets Management Team for the SME loan portfolios administered by HKMC Insurance Limited (HKMCI), a wholly-owned subsidiary of The Hong Kong Mortgage Corporation Limited.

 

Job Descriptions
  • Prepare recovery progress reports on problem loans on a regular basis to management;
  • Prepare various types of management reports on non-performing loan portfolio to analyse performance and provide insights for management decisions;
  • Ensure data accuracy and maintain records in a timely manner;
  • Monitor the quality of special assets management and debt recovery actions, including pursuing legal remedies against defaulted borrowers and personal guarantors, carried out by participating lending institutions;
  • Work independently in coordinating and facilitating debt workouts, and assessing debt workout or repayment proposals for completion in a timely and efficient manner;
  • Provide supervisory support for team operations, augment team capabilities and improve the quality, efficiency, and precision of team operations by leveraging technologies from time to time;
  • Maintain effective communication with both internal and external stakeholders and provide support for matters in relation to the administration of various loan guarantee schemes;
  • Undertake ad hoc assignments or projects from time to time; and 
  • The employment will be on contract basis subject to renewal.

 

Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Accounting, Economics, Finance, Business Administration or related disciplines;
  • A minimum of 6 years’ working experience in special assets management of commercial lending or corporate restructuring / insolvency at any international accounting firm;
  • Strong in analytical skills, organised, and detail-minded;
  • Self-motivated, good at teamwork, and excellent presentation skills;
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Access, Power BI), with knowledge or experience in other data reporting and analytical tools considered a plus;
  • Advanced skills in Excel, including formula application, conditional formatting, and data manipulation; and
  • Excellent command of spoken and written English and Chinese.

     

Candidates with less experience will be considered for the position of Deputy Manager.

 

(Closing Date: 29 October 2026)
